comment: Orange Pi 5 Ultra GPIO pinout using Rockchip RK3588 GPIO mapping
notes: Orange Pi 5 Ultra uses Rockchip RK3588 SoC with multiple GPIO banks
Port mapping per chip: A=0-7, B=8-15, C=16-23, D=24-31
I2C bus 2 is available for ADC/sensors
Secondary ADS1115 can be addressed at 0x49 (address pin pulled high)
GPIO3 and GPIO4 are commonly used for PWM and relays
GPIO1 recommended for buttons with built-in pull-up support
